title: Where does my MP3 start after decoding?
fullTitle: MP3 Encoder Delay: 1105 Samples Late Without the Xing Tag

scenes.narration: You encode one second of sound to M P three, then decode it. Does it come back where it started? One impulse sits at sample four thousand four hundred ten. We read where it lands.
captions: Encode, decode: does the sound start where it did?

scenes.narration: One second, forty four thousand one hundred samples: one impulse, and a one kilohertz tone from the same sample. Control: through P C M, the impulse stays at four thousand four hundred ten. Readers: decoded samples, file bytes, f f probe.
captions: Control: through PCM, the impulse stays at 4410.
Readers: decoded samples, file bytes, ffprobe.

scenes.narration: Encode with lame, constant or variable bit rate, and add dash write underscore x i n g, zero. The impulse returns at five thousand five hundred fifteen: one thousand one hundred five samples late. So does the tone. Out come forty six thousand eighty samples.

Leave the tag on, the default, and the impulse is back at four thousand four hundred ten. The first frame holds no sound: it is an Info frame, or Xing, and its bytes say delay five seventy six, padding fourteen oh four.
captions: The first frame is an Info or Xing tag.

scenes.narration: Forty frames of eleven fifty two make forty six thousand eighty samples. The decoder skips the delay plus five twenty nine, one thousand one hundred five, and trims eight hundred seventy five at the end. Forty four thousand one hundred remain.

Dash c copy of the whole file changes nothing. But dash s s zero point five with dash c copy writes a new tag, delay three thousand five hundred sixty seven. The cut starts three thousand nine hundred eighty one samples late. A re-encode starts exactly.
captions: Re-encode: exact. Copy without tag: 115 early.

scenes.narration: A decoder removes only the delay it is told about. Keep the tag for gapless playback; read the delay field when a cut sounds late. Re-encode for an exact start. Not tested: other builds, real players, other encoders, real music.
captions: Not tested: players, other encoders, real music.
